response.original_title: L’ange Rémi – La liberté à tout prix
response.overview: Rémi Lange has always made films on his own terms: freely, passionately, and without ever asking for permission. From his very first works, he has captured intimacy, bodies, desires, loves, and life on the margins, blurring the line between his own life and his cinema. This radical freedom comes at a price: a body of work that has often remained outside traditional circuits, rarely screened, and largely unknown to the general public. In Marseille, his adopted city and the setting of his latest film, L’Ange Rémi reconnects with this singular filmmaker today. Through his films, personal archives, shoots, and the people who have crossed his path, the documentary tells the story of a man who, for more than thirty years, has kept filming against all odds. He is a filmmaker who may never have received the recognition he hoped for, yet has never given up on what matters most: turning his life into cinema, and his cinema into a space of freedom.
response.title: L’ange Rémi – La liberté à tout prix
